parsed.name: XPS运动控制器
parsed.description: Newport XPS 是一类实验室运动控制器，用于控制电动位移台、定位平台等精密运动设备。它常见于光学实验、自动化测量和精密定位系统中，可通过网络进行控制与配置，并支持在控制器上读写配置或脚本文件。
parsed.description_en: The Newport XPS is a laboratory motion controller used to operate motorized stages, positioning platforms, and other precision motion hardware. It is commonly used in optical experiments, automated measurements, and precision positioning systems, and supports network-based control as well as reading and writing configuration or script files stored on the controller.
